app.tagline: Disaster recovery for the people who live through it
app.demoNotice: Demo with a fictional town and fictional people · PayPal sandbox · no real money moves

login.title: Who are you today?
login.subtitle: The Sablewood Fire is made up, and so are these people. Pick one to see Hearthline through their eyes.
login.error: We couldn't sign you in. Is the API running?

home.inZone: Your home at {{address}} is inside the {{event}} area.
home.notInZone: Your home isn't inside an active disaster area.
home.prepareHint: Keep your inventory current so your claim is ready if disaster strikes.
home.upcomingCall: Video call with {{name}} from the relief network: {{when}}. Have an ID or a bill with your address ready if you can.

coverage.title: Coverage check
coverage.ok: Your policy covers everything found so far.
coverage.noPolicy: Add your policy's contents limit to check your coverage.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.empty: No rooms scanned yet. Start with the room that holds the most valuable things.

comingSoon.title: {{role}} workspace
comingSoon.body: This part of Hearthline is being built. Soon {{name}} will be able to:

donor: Fund specific things a family needs
Give with PayPal, Venmo or Pay Later
contractor: Get paid for each verified milestone
reviewer: Review claims with evidence the AI has gathered
Approve, or ask for more evidence
Verify households on a video call
supervisor: Re-check a random sample of approvals
org_admin: See every household in the disaster area
Send cash aid in one PayPal batch
business: Sell gift cards to regulars now
Receive funds as reopening milestones are met

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Everything in your home, priced for a replacement claim.

scan.title: Scan a room
scan.choose: Add photos or a walkthrough video
scan.hint: Up to 12 photos. Videos are split into still frames on your device.
scan.working: Finding items and checking prices. This takes about 10–20 seconds.

inventory.empty: No items yet. Scan a room to get started.
inventory.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. Please try again.
inventory.hint: Double-click a cell to edit. Right-click a row to delete it or export. Tick Confirmed once you've checked an item.

checklist: IDs, insurance papers and other documents
Phone, chargers and a battery pack
alerts.savedBody: {{count}} items worth {{value}} are stored safely online. You can open or export your claim from any device.

registry.paymentNote: Secure checkout by PayPal. Your payment goes to Hearthline, which buys the item and ships it to the family.
registry.paypalUnavailable: PayPal checkout couldn't load. Please refresh and try again.
registry.thanksBody: We'll buy the item and send it to the family. Your gift now shows on this page.
registry.howBody: Hearthline buys each item from a real store and ships it to the family's verified address. Gifts never go to a stranger's bank account, and every dollar is tracked in a public ledger.
registry.manageSubtitle: List the specific things you need. Donors fund them, and Hearthline buys and ships them to you.
registry.createBody: Your registry shows your town but never your address.
registry.storyPlaceholder: Tell donors what happened and what would help most.

purchases.title: What the Shopper bought
purchases.subtitle: When an item is fully funded, the Shopper agent finds it at an approved store, checks the spending rules, and pays with PayPal.

money.title: Money
money.subtitle: Every dollar given for your family and every dollar spent, recorded twice so the books always balance.
money.empty: No money has moved yet. Donations and purchases will appear here.
money.hint: Click the arrow on a row to see its debits and credits. Drag a column to the bar above to group, or select cells and right-click to chart them.

review.queueSubtitle: Cases assigned to you, {{name}}. The AI has gathered the evidence; you decide.
review.queueHint: Cases are assigned at random. You never review a household you belong to or vouched for. Click a row to open the case.
review.sentinelNote: Sentinel is an AI assistant. It flags and explains; it never approves or rejects. Real victims often lose documents, so a warning is a reason to ask, not proof.
review.videoFirst: This case needs a short video call before you approve it.
review.reasonPlaceholder: Your reason (required to reject or ask for more)
review.reasonRule: Your decision and reason go into the tamper-evident audit log. Nothing is paid until the required reviews agree.

notYourTurn.default: Nothing for you to decide on this case right now.
notYourTurn.needs_info: Waiting for the household to reply.

review.needsLevel2: Cash aid needs verification level 2. Ask for proof of residence, or have a caseworker who isn't reviewing this case vouch for the household.
review.vouchPlaceholder: How do you know this family lives here?

calendar.title: Video calls
calendar.subtitle: Your verification calls. Drag a call to move it; delete it to cancel. Click a call to open its case.

board.title: Case pipeline
board.subtitle: Every case by status. Cases move only when reviewers decide, so the board is read-only. Click a card to open it.

aid.title: Aid
aid.subtitle: Ask for help and follow every request. A person reviews each one before any money moves.

next.address_outside_zone: Your address isn't inside an active disaster area yet. If that's wrong, update your address.
next.confirm_residence: To unlock cash aid, upload proof of residence (a bill or lease) or ask a caseworker to vouch for you. Lost your papers in the fire? A caseworker can vouch instead.
next.scan_before_disaster: Scan your rooms before a disaster to earn the verified inventory badge and speed up claims.

aid.requestBody: Tell us how much you need and what it's for. A reviewer checks it, then PayPal sends the money to your account.
aid.notePlaceholder: What is it for? e.g. motel and groceries while we find a rental

explain.in_review: A reviewer from the relief network is looking at it.
explain.needs_info: A reviewer asked a question. Reply below and the review continues.
explain.escalated: Two reviewers looked at it and a supervisor is making the final call.
explain.approved: Approved. Any cash aid is on its way to your PayPal account.
explain.rejected: This request wasn't approved. You can ask a caseworker about it.

aid.videoNeeded: This request needs a short video call. A reviewer will book a time with you.

rebuild.title: Rebuild
rebuild.subtitle: Hire a licensed contractor and pay as the work gets done. The money waits in escrow, and nothing is paid until you approve.
rebuild.startBody: These contractors have a license checked by Hearthline. The one you invite sends a plan with milestones; you decide whether to accept it.
rebuild.willReview: Approving sends this to a Hearthline reviewer before payment, because of the amount or what the photo check found.
rebuild.willPay: The photos check out. Approving pays {{amount}} to the contractor through PayPal right away.
rebuild.approveToReview: Approve and send to a reviewer
rebuild.disputePlaceholder: Tell the reviewer what isn't finished or isn't right.

explain.pending: Not started yet. The contractor submits photos when it's done.
explain.under_review: A Hearthline reviewer is checking this before the contractor is paid.
explain.disputed: A reviewer is looking at your dispute. The money stays in escrow until it's settled.
explain.refunded: The reviewer agreed with you. This money went back to your fund.

rebuild.escrowHint: Released one milestone at a time
rebuild.awaitingPlan: {{name}} is putting together a plan with milestones, dates and prices.
rebuild.reviewPlan: {{name}} sent a plan. Look over the milestones below.
rebuild.acceptExplain: Accepting moves the full price from your fund into escrow. California caps the deposit at {{cap}} for this price, and every other payment waits for your approval.

gantt.editHint: Drag a milestone that hasn't started to move it. Finished and submitted work stays where it is.
gantt.viewHint: Your contractor keeps this schedule up to date. Green is paid, orange is waiting on you or a reviewer.

contractor.title: Your projects
contractor.subtitle: Families who invited you to rebuild. Send a plan, submit photos when a milestone is done, and get paid through PayPal.
contractor.empty: When a family invites you to send a plan, their project appears here.
contractor.donePlaceholder: What the finished work will look like in photos
contractor.depositCap: Deposit limit: {{cap}} (California: 10% or $1,000, whichever is less)
contractor.send: Send the plan to the family

explain.submitted: Waiting for the homeowner to approve.
explain.under_review: A Hearthline reviewer is checking this milestone before payment.
explain.disputed: The homeowner opened a dispute. A reviewer will decide.

contractor.escrowHint: The family's money is already set aside
contractor.planSent: The family is reviewing your plan. You can still change it until they accept.
contractor.planIntro: Break the job into milestones the family can check with photos. Each one is paid when it's done.

command.title: Command Center
command.subtitle: Every household in the disaster area: what they lost, what they've received, and what they still need.
command.hint: Drag a column such as Damage or Level into the bar above the grid to group. Filters and sorting run on the server, so all households are searched.

batch.title: Batch cash aid
batch.intro: Pay every eligible household in the current view in one PayPal batch. Each household gets the amount for its damage level, never more than it still needs. A second person must approve before any money moves.
batch.scopeFiltered: Covers the households matching the grid's filters on: {{columns}}.
batch.scopeAll: No filters: covers every household. Filter the grid first to target a group.
batch.name: Batch name
batch.tooMany: That's more than one batch can pay. Narrow the filter.
batch.noneLeftOut: Nobody in this view is left out.
batch.secondPerson: After you send it, a different supervisor or admin approves it. Eligibility is checked again then.

reason.shared_paypal: PayPal account shared with another household
reason.recent_aid: Got cash aid in the last 14 days
reason.in_open_batch: Already in a batch waiting for approval
reason.paypal_changed: PayPal account changed since the batch was built
